tasks.api: cargo run -q -p quest --bin quest -- openapi > crates/quest/openapi.json && deno run -A --node-modules-dir npm:openapi-typescript crates/quest/openapi.json -o apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts && treefmt crates/quest/openapi.json apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
